newsitem.title: USA: CACI wins $14.7 million Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: CACI wins $14.7 million Navy contract.

text.p: CACI International Inc said it wan a five-year contract worth an estimated $14.7 million from the U.S. Navy to provide logistics facility operations and maintenance services for the Navy's Integrated Undersea Surveillance System Program.
The IUSS program detects and classifies undersea threats, CACI said. The company began providing full-service operations to the program on November 1.
CACI said its IUSS service includes stocking IUSS facilities and ships, analyzing usage data and maintaining appropriate inventories and managing automated logistics systems.
The company also helps restructure IUSS sites and consolidate assets, provides operational budget and accounting, and administers all operations at the facility, it said.
